item.title: Our potholes on County Road 318 are always filled, but never fixed
item.description: "We also live on County Road 318 in Marion County and it is the same in the area that we live. Right by the I-75. The potholes in the roads are only ever being filled, never fixed. We have been here for almost 15 years and have had to call just to get them to come out and fix them. Right after I-75 heads towards Williston, something needs to be done more about telling cars they also need to slow down for the curves.
